# Tools

## convert-audio-to-base64.html

A simple web tool to convert your MP3 audio files to base64 format so they work without a web server!

### How to use:

1. Open `convert-audio-to-base64.html` in your browser
2. Click "Choose File" and select your MP3 file
3. Click "Convert to Base64"
4. Copy the generated code
5. Paste it into `js/utils/audioData.js` in the `AUDIO_DATA` object

### Example:

After converting `rotate.mp3`, you'll get:
```javascript
rotate: 'data:audio/mpeg;base64,',
```

Then paste it into `audioData.js`:
```javascript
const AUDIO_DATA = {
    rotate: 'data:audio/mpeg;base64,SUQzBAAAAAA...',
    // ... etc
};
```
